reason: Recommend the bounded trigonometric oscillator with arctangent resistance: its training-only fit had the lowest pre-refit validation output RMSE among the delivered families (`0.07191246` in unspecified `y` units, on all validation trajectories excluding their initial rows), with fewer fitted coefficients than Polynomial and less validation error than ForceClamp. Polynomial provides a nonperiodic restoring alternative; ForceClamp provides a sticking-capable alternative. Near-rest drift and validation-trajectory-specific errors remain; no test result is claimed.
